description: Pipe-delimited markdown table with header and alignment row
requirement: CSV parser must handle pipe-delimited markdown tables and skip separator lines.

description: Colon-separated key-value list with mixed casing
requirement: CSV parser must support colon-delimited key:value pairs.

description: Comment lines (#) and blank lines interspersed with holdings
input:
# Q4 Institutional Portfolio

INTC, 25
# Core Cloud
AMZN, 75
requirement: CSV parser must skip comment lines starting with # and blank lines.

description: Three duplicate entries of the same single-letter ticker (C) summed with AAPL
requirement: CSV parser must sum 3+ occurrences of a 1-letter ticker.

description: Numbered list with parenthesis 1) and 2) prefixes
requirement: CSV parser must strip numbered list prefixes like '1)' and '2)' without mistaking the index for weight.

description: Unnormalized basis-point style weights [250, 250, 500] normalize to [25.0, 25.0, 50.0]
requirement: buildPortfolioProfiles must normalize arbitrary positive weight scales to 100.0%.

description: Strict sorting on 7-stock portfolio across all hazard tiers
requirement: Holdings must be strictly ordered from most negative unpricedRiskPct (-2.1%) to least (-0.4%).

description: Asymmetric 4-to-1 portfolio: 4 high-risk stocks (20% each) and 1 low-risk stock (MSFT 20%) limited by MSFT's +5.0 pt cap -> total turnover = 5.0%
requirement: When only 1 low-risk stock is available to absorb reallocated weight, its +5.0 pt cap limits total portfolio one-way turnover to 5.0%.

description: Asymmetric 1-to-4 portfolio: 1 high-risk stock (NEE 40%) and 4 low-risk stocks (15% each) limited by NEE's -5.0 pt cap -> NEE hedgedWeight = 35.0%
requirement: When only 1 high-risk stock is trimmed, its -5.0 pt cap limits total one-way turnover to 5.0%.

description: 12-stock broad portfolio obeys both <= 5.0 pt stock delta and <= 15.0% turnover cap
requirement: 12-stock portfolio must strictly satisfy |delta_i| <= 5.0 and turnover <= 15.0%.

description: Tiny high-risk weight (NEE 1.5%, XOM 48.5%, MSFT 50.0%) clamps NEE reduction at 1.5% (hedgedWeight = 0.0%)
requirement: A high-risk stock with initial weight < 5.0% must be clamped at 0.0% without going negative.

description: Dominant low-risk stock (NEE 3%, MSFT 97%) clamps MSFT increase at +3.0% so MSFT <= 100.0%
requirement: When weight is 97.0% and 3.0%, hedging shifts at most 3.0% so weights stay within [0, 100].

description: Coastal Grid & Data REITs preset improves net Unpriced Risk, Sharpe, and Max Drawdown after tx costs
requirement: Hedged Coastal Grid & Data REITs portfolio must improve net Unpriced Risk, Sharpe, and Max Drawdown.

description: Fault-Line Hardware & Fabs preset lowers Exposure Score (/100) when hedged
requirement: Risk-hedged weights on Fault-Line Hardware & Fabs must lower the portfolio Exposure Score (/100).

description: Mixed known and unseen tickers [PLTR 35, SNOW 35, EQIX 30] obey all hedge and sum constraints
requirement: Unseen tickers mixed with known tickers must obey <= 5.0 pt stock delta, <= 15.0% turnover, and 100.0% sum.
